g.text: BankDash Settings & Preferences Interaction & Animation Locators
Visual mapping of 5 key interactive zones: multi-tab navigation, avatar photo upload & live form validation
Settings Tab Switcher & Indicator Slide
Fluid active indicator transition between Edit Profile, Preferences, and Security tabs
TRIGGER: Clicking settings tab buttons
Avatar Photo Upload Preview & Camera Badge Bounce
Circular avatar with camera badge hover bounce, file picker launch, and instant preview
TRIGGER: Hovering avatar / Uploading new profile photo
Form Input Floating Focus Glow & Real-Time Validation
Luminous mint border glow on focus, date selector styling, and inline validation checkmarks
TRIGGER: Focus and typing in input fields
Save Button Ripple & Glassmorphic Toast Trigger
Tactile button press feedback, simulated network spinner, and floating toast alert
TRIGGER: Clicking Save Changes button
Preferences & 2FA Toggle Switches (Tabs 2 & 3)
Smooth spring sliding switches for Two-Factor Authentication, currency select,
and real-time password strength meter indicator bar
TRIGGER: Switching to Preferences / Security tabs
KEY INTERACTIONS SUMMARY:
Tabs: Sliding Indicator
Avatar: Upload Preview
Form: Focus Glow
Save: Toast Feedback
Security: 2FA Switches
All interactions use GPU hardware-accelerated transforms & zero-layout-shift (CLS = 0.00) with accessible aria controls.
